tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
ssoNotInvited: This Microsoft account has no OCTA BMS access yet. Ask an administrator for an invitation.
sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
signedOutElsewhere: You signed out in another tab.
policyReauth: Your organization now requires two-step verification. Sign in to set it up.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.prompt: Open Microsoft Authenticator and enter the 6-digit code for OCTA BMS.
mfa.invalid: That code is not valid. {{count}} attempts left.
mfa.expired: This sign-in attempt expired. Please sign in again.

recovery.title: Use a recovery code
recovery.prompt: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step verification.
recovery.oneTime: Each code works only once. After signing in, generate new codes if you are running low.
recovery.invalid: That recovery code is not valid or was already used.

setup.title: Set up Microsoft Authenticator
setup.required: Your organization requires two-step verification before you can continue.
setup.step1: Open Microsoft Authenticator on your phone.
setup.step2: Tap + and choose “Other account (Google, Facebook, etc.)”.
setup.step3: Scan the QR code below (or enter the key manually).
setup.step4: Enter the current 6-digit code to confirm.
setup.step5: Save your recovery codes in a safe place.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for adding OCTA BMS to Microsoft Authenticator
setup.manualKey: Can’t scan? Enter this key manually
setup.invalidCode: That code did not match. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
setup.replaceWarning: Replacing your authenticator deactivates the current one and your existing recovery codes.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.intro: If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. They are shown only now — OCTA BMS cannot show them again.
codes.ack: I stored these codes somewhere safe (password manager or printed and locked away).
codes.fileHeader: OCTA BMS recovery codes — each code can be used once.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.prompt: Enter your work email. If an account exists, we will send a link that is valid for a short time.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, we sent instructions. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password changed. All other sessions were signed out. Please sign in.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. Long passphrases work well; password managers welcome.

invite.title: Join OCTA BMS
invite.done: Account created. Sign in to set up Microsoft Authenticator.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used.

stepUp.title: Confirm it’s you
stepUp.totp: Enter the current code from Microsoft Authenticator to continue.

security.title: Security
security.turnOffConfirm: Enter a current code to turn off two-step verification.
security.recoveryLow: You are running low on recovery codes.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

admin.title: Security administration
admin.policyHelp: Roll out in order: optional → enrollment required (with deadline) → enforced. Enforcement needs at least two administrators with MFA and saved recovery codes.
admin.verification: How was identity verified out of band?
admin.dualControl: A different administrator must approve. Completing removes the user’s authenticator, recovery codes and sessions; they must enroll again.
admin.inviteNotSent: Invitation created but email delivery failed — check mail configuration.
